content.description: Every Epoch we draw winners from our delegates to receive random NFT Drops! Staking to our pool will earn you the chance to win some of the many NFT projects we partner with! We work tirelessly to get our pool into whitelists for projects so that YOU can get free NFTs! Staking 100 ADA will earn you 1 Raffle Ticket per Epoch, the more you stake the more opportunity you have to earn some fresh (and some classic) NFTs At RAFL, we believe that staking your ADA should be the way to win NFTs, not buying tickets. That's why we've built our raffle platform on the Cardano blockchain, allowing you to stake your ADA to enter our raffles and win valuable NFTs.
